headline: HoverAir’s transforming modular drone has already been halted in the US
summary: The HoverAir Versa, a modular drone/steadycam, halted US orders after three days. The FCC's drone ban appears to have caused the halt. Shipping to US customers may also be abandoned.

headline: TikTok will pay $400 million to settle DOJ child privacy lawsuit
summary: TikTok will pay $400 million to settle a 2024 DOJ lawsuit. The lawsuit alleged violations of the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). TikTok was accused of collecting child data without parental consent and not deleting accounts.

headline: Over 1 million people have clicked LinkedIn’s AI slop button
summary: LinkedIn's "Seems like AI slop" button has been clicked over a million times. The feature was announced on July 30th. It allows users to flag AI-generated content perceived as low quality.

headline: Apple is laying off staffers working on the Vision Pro and Siri
summary: Apple is conducting layoffs within its Vision Pro and Siri teams. This includes largely shutting down a Vision Pro gaming team. Over 200 jobs were cut, affecting Vision Pro immersive content creation.

headline: The Sinking City 2 Review
summary: The Sinking City 2 is described as an "off-brand Resident Evil." It's a praiseworthy imitation inspired by the Cthulhu mythos. The review highlights its core gameplay loop and thematic elements.

headline: 'Hoping for a Huge October Surprise, But Not Holding My Breath' — Arc Raiders Players Torn After Embark Delays Future Expeditions Until Early 2027
summary: Embark Studios has delayed all future Arc Raiders Expeditions until early 2027. The delay aims to implement major improvements based on community feedback. Players express mixed feelings, with some hoping for a surprise and others expressing resignation.

headline: Save $800 Off This Top-Tier iBuypower Gaming PC With AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D CPU and 5090 GPU
summary: An iBuypower gaming PC with AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D CPU and 5090 GPU is on sale. Save $800 on this top-tier configuration. It includes 32GB DDR5-6000MHz RAM, a 4TB SSD, and a 3-year warranty.

headline: Amazon Has Box Set Deals Hidden Deep Within Its BOGO 50% Off Book Sale
summary: Amazon is running a Buy One Get One 50% Off book sale. The sale includes hidden deals on book box sets. Shoppers can find significant savings on collections.

headline: Canada says it will match US tariffs 'dollar for dollar' as trade talks break down
summary: Canada will match new US tariffs "dollar for dollar." This follows a breakdown in trade talks between the two nations. A 50% levy on $20bn of Canadian imports will come into force.

headline: Girl, 6, dies days after Shoreham sea tragedy killed three family members
summary: A 6-year-old girl has died days after a sea tragedy in Shoreham. She is the fourth family member to die after getting into difficulty in the water. The incident occurred off the coast of West Sussex.

headline: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
summary: TikTok will pay $400 million to the US to settle a child privacy lawsuit. This is one of the largest settlements of its kind. The 2024 lawsuit alleged collection of vast data from users under 13.

headline: More students planning to live at home for university over 'insane' living costs
summary: More students are opting to live at home for university. This decision is driven by "insane" living costs. Students worry about missing out on student life but feel they have no choice.
